answer_1.quote: Our model ( §3) leverages gold reference summaries to derive training datasets for several summarization sub-tasks...Finally, we created training data for a BART-based model for sentence fusion
answer_1.outputs: bullet-style abstractive summary of individual concise and coherent sentences

answer_2.quote: Following common practice, we evaluate and compare our summarization system with ROUGE-1/2/SU4 F1 measures

answer_4.quote: Crowdworkers on Amazon Mechanical Turk were shown the summaries for a given topic from the three systems in arbitrary order, along with a corresponding reference summary. They were asked to rank the systems with respect to Content (content overlap with the reference), Readability (the degree to which a summary is readable and well-understood), Grammaticality (avoiding grammar errors), and Non-Redundancy (avoiding information repetition).
answer_4.guideline: rank the systems with respect to Content, Readability, Grammaticality, and Non-Redundancy
